data.title: Agents reach for search on their own
data.description: Measured 2026-09-28 (notes on KAD-50): an agent forced to start with search answered 19/20 against 17/20 without, at half the context (median 6.0k vs 11.9k tokens) and half the time. But nothing makes an agent start with it: the SessionStart hook runs prime, prime's Go deeper does not mention search, and the instruction section lists it as one command among eleven. The agent writing those notes reached for decision list and grep first. Make the instructions an agent actually reads - prime and the kadence section of AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / .kadence/README.md - say when to search and why, and measure the change in natural mode (search allowed, never named in the prompt) before and after.
